description: Orders are stored in a nested BigQuery table with a repeated STRUCT of line items and a repeated STRUCT of order-level discounts. Compute revenue per product category. Line gross = unit_price * quantity. The total of an order's discounts is allocated to its lines in proportion to line gross. Category comes from the products table via sku (unknown sku -> category 'uncategorized'). Output columns: category (STRING), gross_revenue (FLOAT64), net_revenue (FLOAT64, gross minus allocated discount, 2 decimals), order_count (INT64, distinct orders with at least one line in the category). Sort by category.

line_items.type: ARRAY<STRUCT<sku STRING, unit_price FLOAT64, quantity INT64>>
line_items.description: Repeated line items; may be an empty array

discounts.description: Repeated order-level discounts; may be empty

edge_cases: Order 1 has 2 line items and 2 discounts; unnesting both arrays in one FROM clause yields 4 rows
Order 3 has line items but an empty discounts array and must not be dropped
Order 2 has an empty line_items array and contributes nothing
An order whose gross is 0 must not cause division by zero during allocation
common_failure_modes: FM1: CROSS JOIN UNNEST(line_items), UNNEST(discounts) creates a cartesian product (gross doubled) and drops orders with an empty discounts array
FM4: Comma/CROSS JOIN UNNEST removes rows with empty arrays; LEFT JOIN UNNEST or a correlated subquery is needed
FM3: Subtracting the full order discount from every line instead of allocating it proportionally
